chapter: Return to New Orleans and Sharkey
title: Riverboat work and Tony Almerico
summary: He worked briefly with Almerico on the steamer and recalls him fondly, paying for meals and visiting the Dream Room.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: What about the river boats? Did you ever work on them ever?

Well, they were on the steaming capitol on the... well I worked with different bands, you know? Mm-hmm. In fact, when I came back from Hollywood, I worked with Tony Amarica about two or three weeks, you know, on the boat with him.

And Tony and I, to the last day, you know, he walked on Bourbon Street, he used to come back to the Dream Room when I was at the Dream Room, remember? Mm-hmm. And he said, Santa, I can't walk anymore, so I don't think I'll see him. But he used to be there every night, he used to come there every night to see me. Tony was a nice guy, a lot of musicians, all night Tony, I don't know why.
I always got along with him, he was always very nice to me.
Yeah. Yeah. Physicians thought he was tight and all that stuff, but I can't say that about Tony.

But we'd travel, like we'd play one night stand, like Block City or Mobile or something like that, and we'd stop and he said, man, Tony Amarica's got his first knuckle, but he used to pay for my food, not that I wanted him to pay for my food. Yeah. But he asked me, he said, Santa, would you want to pray this job? He said, yeah, I liked Tony. I used to go there and jam on a Sunday with him, you know? Mm-hmm.
